report.summary: Applied exactly two labels to bench/bench-repo issue #4 "{{v1}}" using the sidebar Labels picker: 'bug' and 'priority-high', and no others. Notable mechanics: clicking items in the picker only toggles their local .checked tick (no request is sent); the selection is committed by the sidebar combo component when the dropdown is hidden — closing it fired two fetch requests to /bench/bench-repo/issues/labels?issue_ids=4, which is what actually applied the labels. Verification from the server response (fetch_source, i.e. raw HTTP body, not just the live DOM): the sidebar labels-list now renders exactly two badges, bug (label id 1) and priority-high (label id 2), the "No labels" placeholder span is now class "item empty-list tw-hidden", the picker shows documentation and enhancement still unchecked, and the issue timeline records "added the bug, priority-high labels". The live DOM matches, and the page is still {{v3}} at http://127.0.0.1:8095/bench/bench-repo/issues/4.
